description: Data Protection Officer has not been provided with necessary resources, support, or access to perform required tasks effectively. Article 38.2 requires controllers to support DPO in performing tasks.
applicability: Applicable to all organizations with designated DPO. Controller must provide resources including staff, premises, equipment, and access to personal data and processing operations.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through assessment of DPO resources, budget allocation, staff support, and access to data and systems.
